name: Imouto "Onee-chan Kuso Bitch Nande Watashi ni Shimasen ka"
original_name: 妹「お姉ちゃんクソビッチなんで私にしませんか」
source:
Konoka brought home a guy and did everything to him.
Her little sister Sayaka was tired of this.
"You should know my sister is a huge slut," she said.
